  "contract": "Any client-side cache key used to memoize an available-slots response must include every request parameter that can change the set of slots the server returns. Because an event type with a restriction schedule evaluated with `useBookerTimezone` computes a different set of bookable slots per requesting `timeZone`, the visitor's timezone is a slot-determining input, not a mere display setting; therefore every React Query key that caches `/slots/available` (or the equivalent tRPC/API v2 slots response) must be keyed on `timeZone` so that changing the timezone produces a cache miss and a refetch rather than serving the slots computed for the previous timezone until the query cache is discarded by a page reload.",
  "defect_location": {
    "repo": "calcom/cal.com",
    "summary": "The server already makes slot computation timezone-dependent for restriction schedules: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots/util.ts:1271-1284 picks `restrictionTimezone = eventType.useBookerTimezone ? input.timeZone : restrictionSchedule.timeZone`, and packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/ensureAvailableUsers.ts:170-200 does the same at booking time, so two requests differing only in `timeZone` legitimately yield different slot sets. The server-side redis memo is safe because its key is the whole input (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots/util.ts:97-98, `cacheKey = JSON.stringify(args.input)`). The defect is in the two browser-side caches. (1) The embeddable/platform Booker: packages/platform/atoms/booker/BookerPlatformWrapper.tsx:284-310 correctly passes `timeZone: timezone` (from `useTimePreferences()`, packages/platform/atoms/booker/BookerPlatformWrapper.tsx:246) into `useAvailableSlots`, but packages/platform/atoms/hooks/useAvailableSlots.ts:19-33 builds its React Query key from only startTime, endTime, eventTypeId, eventTypeSlug, isTeamEvent, teamId, usernameList, routedTeamMemberIds, skipContactOwner, teamMemberEmail and rrHostSubsetIds — `rest.timeZone` is absent, while `rest` (including timeZone) is what is actually sent as params at packages/platform/atoms/hooks/useAvailableSlots.ts:34-38. Changing the timezone therefore hits the same cache entry and no refetch is issued. (2) The web booking page: apps/web/modules/schedules/hooks/useSchedule.ts:94-120 puts `timeZone: timezone ?? \"PLACEHOLDER_TIMEZONE\"` into `input` and, for team events with API v2 enabled (apps/web/modules/schedules/hooks/useSchedule.ts:144-154, reached because `useScheduleForEvent` defaults `useApiV2 = true` at apps/web/modules/schedules/hooks/useEvent.ts:72 and restriction schedules are a team-gated feature per packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots/util.ts:1268-1271), routes the fetch through apps/web/modules/schedules/hooks/useApiV2AvailableSlots.ts:17-31, whose query key likewise omits `rest.timeZone` even though `rest` is forwarded as params at apps/web/modules/schedules/hooks/useApiV2AvailableSlots.ts:32-35. The timezone value itself does propagate reactively (packages/features/bookings/Booker/hooks/useBookerTime.ts:6-20 over packages/features/bookings/Booker/store.ts:562-565 and packages/features/bookings/lib/timePreferences.ts:21-32), so the stale display is purely the missing cache-key dimension, which is why only a full reload — which discards the query cache — shows the restriction applied in the new zone.",
